title: AiUsageIndicator: render the reset line for resetKind 'fiveHour' (cloud#2059 rolling 5-hour pace window)
body:
Category ②: a consumer follow-up to a ruled producer change. Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat (`repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01Wxo1xhh2bU66T73q23jzE4`, R44), as promised in its review of cloud#2059 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2059, comment 5943224275, item 1).

## Why

objectstack-ai/cloud#2059 (ruled A, batch #264 item 4) replaces the paid plan's monthly allowance and daily burst with two rolling windows, on every plan:
- `weekly`: the 7-day budget;
- `fiveHour`: the 5-hour pace, a rate limit that stops a runaway agent loop within minutes.

Its code PR, objectstack-ai/cloud#2574, changes `GET /api/v1/ai/usage`:
- `resetKind` is now `'weekly' | 'fiveHour'` (the quota policy's `WindowKind`). `daily` and `monthly` are no longer emitted.
- `resetsAt` is the binding window's reset instant. It is one window length after the oldest still-counted usage in that window: 7 days for `weekly`, 5 hours for `fiveHour`. It is `null` when nothing is counted in that window yet.

The indicator already handles `weekly` (objectui#7371). For any other kind it renders no reset line. So when the 5-hour pace binds, a user who has hit the wall sees no line telling them when they can continue. That moment is when the line matters most.

## Readings (objectui `main` `5262f7d`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts:36`: `export type AiUsageResetKind = 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly';`
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx:180-187`, `resetLabel`: the `daily`, `monthly` and `weekly` arms, then `return null`.
- `AiUsageIndicator.tsx:164-172`, `weeklyResetLabel`: "Resets in N hours" inside the final day, else "Resets in N days". It is derived only from `resetsAt` and the measured `now`.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: `resetsWeeklyHours` / `resetsWeeklyDays` (each a plural family) are in all 10 packs.

## Acceptance

- `AiUsageResetKind` gains `'fiveHour'`, matching the cloud wire vocabulary.
- For `fiveHour`, the reset line reads "Resets in N hours", derived only from `resetsAt` and `now`, the same way the weekly arm is (`resetsAt` is the one source of the reset instant; it is never re-derived client-side). There is no line while `resetsAt` is `null` or `now` is not yet measured.
- Under one hour, the line does not read "Resets in 0 hours". Rounding up to one hour, as the weekly arm does, is acceptable; a minutes arm is the implementer's call.
- An unknown `resetKind` still renders no reset line (objectui#7371's soft-fail stays).
- Removing the retired `daily` / `monthly` arms is in scope only if the cloud side no longer emits them on any deployed control plane. ⚠️ Production cloud still serves `v1.33.0`, which emits them, so keep them until a cloud release carries #2574.
- Any new i18n key family is in every locale pack (`all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`).
- A test pins the `fiveHour` arm: a reset instant 3 hours out reads "Resets in 3 hours", and `resetsAt: null` renders no line.

## Not in scope

- The cloud side. objectstack-ai/cloud#2574 owns the wire shape, and nothing about it changes here.
- The `topUp` CTA. It already follows the wire's `topUp` flag, which since #2574 is set only when the 7-day window binds.
